description: This file is a Node.js entry point script for the openclaw project, handling environment checks, module imports, error handling, and CLI behaviors.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses a raw Node.js version string into major and minor version numbers.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if the current Node.js version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Verifies Node.js version and exits if requirement is not met.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a module not found error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a module not found for a specific specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to import and install process warning filters from specific modules.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module, returning true on success, false if module not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file URL exists.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message indicating missing build output and suggests actions.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Detects if the script is invoked with help flags.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed CLI help text from a JSON file.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output CLI help, either from precomputed data or modules.
